mathematics.assertion_tested: 41 deterministic checks of Duffing orbital harmonics, single-notch leakage, delayed-OU spectrum, quadratic diffusion, detuning floor, bounded finite-time fluctuations, and toy selector power.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE float64 with SciPy adaptive quadrature and central finite differences.
mathematics.conventions: Dimensionless Duffing lambda=ER=1; h=x; two-sided spectrum S=int C(t) exp(-i omega t) dt; D=variance/2time; coefficient of noise amplitude squared.
non_claims: No empirically measured spectrum, no carrier-derived delay, no reservoir backreaction.
Second-order weak-noise diffusion zero is not an exact finite-amplitude barrier.
Finite harmonic convergence checks do not bound an arbitrary infinite harmonic tail.
